headline: CONTRA's second seat now arrives like the cabinet — and gives itself back
lede: The forge's spare-cycle rung picked CONTRA off the weakest spot on the shelf and shipped the co-op seat ceremony: player two rappels in at your side instead of puppeteering the wingman, and a seat nobody drives returns to the CPU after ten seconds. Both flagship commissions — Double Dragon and R-TYPE — are now fully live, S1 through co-op.

notes.text: CONTRA seat ceremony (#2837, merged 06e6806): drop-in = fresh soldier on a rappel, hero-side, mercy invulnerability, clean rifle; touching keys mid-death-tumble skips the respawn wait entirely.

Drop-out finally exists: an idle human seat hands the stick back to the wingman brain — cost-free from the shared pool, with a mercy window and its own chirp. Any press keeps the seat; re-touch arrives on the rope again.
R-TYPE S4 co-op landed on slot b (#2838): the twin commission Jon ordered in #2795 is complete — Double Dragon and R-TYPE both run two pilots, CPU ally by default, keyboard 2P drop-in.

jalfern.com's proxied index.html keeps naming the previous bundle for ~10 minutes after a deploy — content verification must fetch the new chunk by name (asset paths proxy live) instead of trusting the served HTML.
